import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_digits
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

digits = load_digits()
X, y = digits.data / 16, digits.target
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)


a=LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000).fit(X_train,y_train);b=KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=3).fit(X_train,y_train)
acc_lr=round(float(a.score(X_test,y_test)),3);acc_knn=round(float(b.score(X_test,y_test)),3)
